mod.overview: Tribes Arena v3.0 (Rasia through v2.3; Lizard v2.4-3.0, June 2002, arena.cs & ArenaConfig.cs) preserves Base 1.11 weapon/light/medium stats while banning Heavy Armor, Mortar, Mines, Turret Pack, and Deployable Inv/Ammo Stations, capping Laser Rifles at 3 per team in Public Mode, and running multi-round last-team-standing arena elimination.
notes: Explicit bans & team caps (arena.cs, ArenaConfig.cs): sets $TeamItemMax[HeavyArmor] = 0 (bans Heavy Armor), bans Mortar and MortarAmmo ($InvList = $RemoteInvList = 0), bans Mines ($InvList = $RemoteInvList = $AmmoPackMax = 0), bans TurretPack ($InvList = $RemoteInvList = 0), bans DeployableInvPack and DeployableAmmoPack ($InvList = 0), and caps Laser Rifle at 3 per team in Public Mode ($SniperRifleLimitInPubMode = 3).

Match & anti-spam rules in arena.cs: enforces full friendly fire ($Server::TeamDamageScale = 1), 240 s round timers ($Arena::GameTimeLimit), 4-round Pub / 5-round Match win targets over 3-map sets, 5 s inventory station reuse cooldown + 75-buy cap, 32 s AFK observer ejection, and lizStats.cs performance tracking.

HeavyArmor.summary: Banned in Tribes Arena via $TeamItemMax[HeavyArmor] = 0 in arena.cs.
notes: Players fight strictly in Light Armor and Medium Armor.

Mortar.summary: Banned at both main and remote Inventory Stations ($InvList = $RemoteInvList = 0).
notes: MortarAmmo is also disabled from stations.

MortarAmmo.summary: Banned at both main and remote Inventory Stations ($InvList = $RemoteInvList = 0).
notes: Pairs with Mortar ban in arena.cs.

MineAmmo.summary: Banned at both main and remote stations ($InvList = $RemoteInvList = 0) with AmmoPackMax zeroed ($AmmoPackMax[MineAmmo] = 0).
notes: Removes mine traps from arena rounds.

TurretPack.summary: Banned at both main and remote stations ($InvList = $RemoteInvList = 0).
notes: Prevents turret camping during elimination rounds.
Forces players to rely on map stations or limited supply.
Forces players to rely on map stations or limited supply.

LaserRifle.summary: Limited to 3 per team in Public Mode ($SniperRifleLimitInPubMode = 3 in ArenaConfig.cs); damage and energy stats remain stock Base.
notes: Match mode clears the team cap unless configured.
